propositions: Anthropic and OpenAI usage rows fail to price when model_ref is stored with provider prefix (e.g. anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6) because genai-prices cannot resolve prefixed model ids, while Bedrock happens to resolve, creating silent asymmetry in cost comparisons
LookupError from genai_prices.calc_price is caught without warning and silently converts rows to unpriced, making pricing failures indistinguishable from genuinely unknown models
Provider-cost comparison output shows only Bedrock with cost figures while Anthropic and OpenAI arms appear empty, biasing the reader toward incorrect conclusions about provider expense

Model id translation must use REGISTRY MEMBERSHIP to decide provider-aware conversions rather than prefix-stripping, because Bedrock versioned ids like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 would be broken by blind split(":")
Unpriced rows must remain tolerated as best-effort but must be visibly distinguishable in output based on whether the id was genuinely unknown vs malformed
